{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"## Tool Use

Use the provided tool `extracted_data` to extract correct and accurate structured data from the input.

Tool purpose: Function call based on user instructions.

Call the tool with the best supported arguments for the requested extraction."},{"role":"user","content":"Given the following text by a user, extract the part
that is actually relevant to their question. Include
the actual question or query that the user is asking.

Text by user:
Mary has 3 times as much candy as Megan.
Mary then adds 10 more pieces of candy to her collection.
Max is 5 years older than Mary.
If Megan has 5 pieces of candy, how many does Mary have in total?"}],"max_completion_tokens":1024,"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"extracted_data","description":"Function call based on user instructions.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"relevantContext":{"type":"string","description":"All numerical facts and operations from the text that are needed to answer the question — do not omit any numbers or math steps"},"userQuery":{"type":"string","description":"The exact question from the user"}},"required":["relevantContext","userQuery"],"additionalProperties":false}}}],"tool_choice":{"type":"function","function":{"name":"extracted_data"}}}
